subject: Security architecture & SOC2 evidence review — scheduling and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Sharma <maya.sharma@carenova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Security architecture & SOC2 evidence review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, the best next step is a 60-minute architecture deep-dive focused on the items SOC 2 auditors typically request: encryption at rest/in transit, KMS/HSM options, audit logging retention, SSO/SAML flows, and evidence collection process.

We can run this session as a joint call with your infrastructure and security team; we'll bring Rishi (security lead) and Laura (solutions architect). Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Tuesday 11/24 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wednesday 11/25 09:00–10:00 PT
- Friday 11/27 13:00–14:00 PT

If none of those work, send a couple of alternatives or a calendar invite and we’ll make it work. I’ve attached a lightweight SOC2 evidence checklist and our recommended network diagram to speed collection.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx, network-diagram-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0137

On behalf of Redwood Inference — production-first inference for secure deployments
From: Maya Sharma <maya.sharma@carenova.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Timothy Jenkins <timothy.jenkins@carenova.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security architecture & SOC2 evidence review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Thanks Priyom —

Appreciate the checklist and diagram. Quick heads-up: our security lead (Tim) is unavailable 11/24–11/25. Friday 11/27 13:00–14:00 PT looks good for us. Would you be able to push the meeting to 14:00–15:00 PT instead? We have a standing backlog review at 13:00 that runs long most weeks.

We'll invite the cloud infra and compliance owners. Also — can you confirm whether the checklist has example artifacts (e.g., sample key rotation policy, SSO assertion log export format)? If not, we may ask for a follow-up deliverable.

Best,
Maya Sharma
Director of IT & Security, CareNova Health
maya.sharma@carenova.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Sharma <maya.sharma@carenova.com>, Timothy Jenkins <timothy.jenkins@carenova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security architecture & SOC2 evidence review — scheduling and evidence handoff

Thanks, Maya — Friday 11/27 at 14:00–15:00 PT works for our team; I’ve updated the proposed slot. Laura — can you confirm Rishi’s availability for that hour? Dev, can you stand by to pull the example export snippets (SSO assertion export, audit-log CSV) into the Drive folder before the call?

To answer your artifact question: the checklist includes references to example artifacts (file names and types) but not full sample policies. We can attach a redacted key-rotation policy and an example assertion log export as part of pre-read if that helps. Planning note: we’ll keep the first 15 minutes high-level architecture, then deep-dive into evidence mapping and collection steps.

I’ll send a calendar invite once everyone confirms.

Priyom
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Sharma <maya.sharma@carenova.com>, Timothy Jenkins <timothy.jenkins@carenova.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security architecture & SOC2 evidence review — scheduling and evidence handoff

All good from my side — Rishi confirmed 11/27 14:00–15:00 PT.

Dev — can you drop the following into the shared Drive by EOB Thursday (11/26)?
- Redacted KMS key-rotation policy (PDF)
- Example SSO assertion export (CSV)
- Example audit-log export (CSV)

I’ll also upload an updated network diagram with our recommended VPC peering notes and the mapping table that ties audit log sources to typical SOC2 controls (CC6, CC7). That mapping will be our working doc during the call.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
